text:
# RN V2 actual-program construction: Owner specification

Scope: S04/B13 construction only. RN V2 original46-strategy lineage and the18BM descriptor stay unchanged. No RN V2.1/V3 substitution; no R0 scientific PASS from construction tests. The qualified v1_8 Runtime/host is read-only. No new actual source, authority, approval or deployment is installed.

## 1. Deliver two distinct executable program controls

`adapter_program.py: adapt(admitted_bundle) -> dict`
`evaluator_program.py: evaluate(admitted_bundle, candidate) -> dict`

They are UTF8 source bytes loaded by the existing `r0_engine_v1.loader.load_program` under the existing role/call-contract tuples, then called by `r0_actual_research_runtime_v1_8.execution.run_adapter/run_evaluator`. No direct import of the program substitutes for these checks. `adapter_program` role METHODOLOGY_ADAPTER / R0_PKG_ADAPTER_CALL_V1, `evaluator_program` role EVALUATOR / R0_PKG_EVALUATOR_CALL_V1. Different code_record_key, raw source hash and namespace; isolation checked.

The existing runtime preloads only hashlib and json. Keep import_allowlist a subset of those two. Do not weaken the frozen loader, invent an import escape or call open/exec/eval/importlib/project modules. Programs consume only the supplied five-key bundle (im,im_raw_sha256,roots,controls,bundle_digest); no filesystem, caller path, socket, registry, source-port object or callback. Audit observation is not OS isolation.

The adapter's allowed view contains only pkg.input_refs roots, its own program control, the scope control and actual schema controls; package/expected/evaluator-spec/evaluator-source controls are withheld. All34 original source roots are GIT_BLOB/SNAPSHOT_FILE; do NOT relabel generated controls as historical snapshots or abuse schema_refs to expose arbitrary data. Package-specific recompute selector/control bindings may be compiled into the adapter source as declared methodology data: only derivations from the frozen selector spec and actual source metadata, never expected values or precomputed observed records. Retain a field-level compilation map. The final source must be complete and frozen before FINAL; no hidden source generator or extra compiled program outside the14-file roster. If selecting a source-derived range/table, verify its source/hash join on supplied roots before using it.

Reimplement the necessary pure calculation closure in these two source members, reusing source algorithms and recording provenance. Helpers may be small/duplicated between the independently loaded programs; they cannot share mutable state or import the expected compiler. Code reuse does not authorize external I/O. A facade around a hard-coded candidate is not an implementation. Source-dependent variations must reach changed observations or a typed refusal. Special-purpose parsing must cover the exact pinned RN V2 domain (including the supported literal/CSV/legacy JSON cases) and refuse out-of-domain data; do not silently approximate a recipe. Use existing kernels/plugin as the conformance oracle OUTSIDE the sealed program call.

Adapter returns exactly `{files,data_result_digest}`. `files` is exactly the four frozen DR filenames and canonical JSON-plus-LF bytes; derive input manifest/node/bundle joins and J.data_result_digest exactly as execution._check_candidate requires. Full closed DR1–DR4 validation and all source-grounded coverage/identity/disposition rows are mandatory. A partial, component-only or fabricated base/forward identity is never complete. Candidate DR1 is not the evaluator's proof; the independent evaluator and parent judge determine disposition.

Evaluator returns exactly `{checks,outcome}`. Each CheckItem is exactly check_id,status,subject_record_key,expected,observed using existing vocabulary. Cover every bound expected value and baseline artifact; no empty-set PASS, duplicate/drop-to-pass or final-outcome override. Compare the immutable candidate against separately bound expected controls from the full bundle; recheck candidate raw/core/digest/context and complete required set. Do not compute expected from candidate or reuse adapter observations as expected. Existing judge_report and schema validation must accept/refuse the result for the right reasons.

The18 measurements retain their exact source rules and recipes. In documentary-only evidence BM01 and BM17 retain OPERATIONAL_HOLD; a calculated mechanical digest is not proof of actual admission/post-read. Controlled SUPPORT fixtures may supply correctly tagged operational witnesses solely to exercise complete-path logic. This must not promote those fixtures, historical16MATCH+2HOLD results or HOLD statuses into actual R0 evidence. Unknown actual bindings remain HOLD. Do not force any exact scientific mismatch count.

## 2. Private construction interfaces (new helpers; not new business schemas)

`source_map.compile_recompute_spec(descriptor_raw: bytes, descriptor_ref: dict) -> runtime.records.Step`: exact-byte pin, closed required set and recompute selector-only view, compare with Owner RN_V2_RECOMPUTE_SELECTOR_SPEC. The result excludes expected_rule values. Missing/contradictory bindings return existing typed HOLD/REFUSED.

`source_map.program_compilation_map(adapter_raw: bytes, selector_spec: dict, admitted_source_refs: list) -> Step`: provenance for every embedded range/control/constant, raw source and selector joins, and explicit absence of expected-value carriers. It must not claim static inspection alone proves semantic separation; consumer tests establish the other half.

`package_builder.build_package(adapter_raw: bytes, evaluator_raw: bytes, expected_controls: dict, source_bindings: dict, context: dict) -> Step`: construct existing METHODOLOGY_PACKAGE_V3, code controls, independent evaluator spec and applicable verifier-definition proposal from exact supplied bytes/refs. Input roles/source schemas/expected refs are explicit; constructor validation is not adoption. `context` is a closed private construction context defined and frozen in CASE_PLAN before tests; it supplies node, method/package/interface identities and validity window plus source-bound schemas/scope bindings. No default accepted signer/root/clock/issuer/status. Missing actual context yields HOLD; explicit SUPPORT fixtures remain SUPPORT. No placeholder hashes or future approvals.

`package_builder.validate_package_artifacts(artifacts: dict) -> Step`: existing package.check_programs/check_interface/check_package and closed source/compiler joins; no local success boolean shortcut.

`cli.main(argv: list[str]) -> int`: `plan`/`status` read-only; `run`/`execute` actual route unavailable; no --accepted/--approve switch. Default returns HOLD/exit2, zero effects. Engineering preparation outputs only under the registered fresh run root. This new CLI is construction tooling, not the R0 actual entry.

No change to the engine/runtime public signatures or records is authorized. If a concrete missing field/source prevents these interfaces, report the precise source clause and dependency before attempting a workaround. Continue independent permitted tests; do not silently change baseline/expected/loader/view policy.

## 3. Conformance and real consumer path

Drive source-bound package construction from the existing P51 profile and approved documentary selector/mapping/extraction bytes; reuse the existing18BM kernels as oracle, not as a runtime import in the sealed program call. Account for all18 rows, inputs and per-row evidence. Use supplied buffer copies, not ambient repo reads inside LOAD/CALL. Read-only fixture/preparation may access only SOURCE_PINS and registered generated files under the correct finite role; don't add a repository-prefix read allowlist.

At least one real child role must consume the actual frozen adapter/evaluator source bytes through the existing loader and frozen verifier-worker contract, then generate exact five-file spool under SUPPORT engineering authority. The adapter's computed DR rows and evaluator evidence must be what the parent actually reads/judges; spy-only wiring or a separate calculator is insufficient. A subprocess role must bind pinned interpreter, frozen worker/argv/env/registered cwd and counts; fresh-process reopen verifies retained output. Never use actual public R0 entry with fabricated accepted source/commissioning proofs. No full inherited328-case campaign is needed because runtime/host is unchanged; targeted interface/consumer cases are required.

## 4. Explicit AILL boundary

No AILL endpoint, owner semantic truth, shadow writer/store or additional ledger is built by this task. N2 construction was separated after source review: logical AdapterResult may claim durability only AFTER the single Runtime writer associates the fact/witness. Runtime private respond returns material; it is not that finalized logical result. The next AILL design must close that sequencing join. Observe/ack logical signatures, MR5 attest/claim and MR6 trust remain unchanged; unresolved join is reported, not patched by a fabricated callback/witness. This separation narrows the previous combined forecast; it does not change the selected full O/A acceptance requirement.
